// diagnostic

E0067

Source-written `__name` is reserved for Jet and generated tooling; visible machine names use `__jet_` (D-SHAPE-DUNDER2=A, D-NAME-SIGIL1=A)

What

Source-written `__name` is reserved for Jet and generated tooling; visible machine names use `__jet_` (D-SHAPE-DUNDER2=A, D-NAME-SIGIL1=A)

Why

The registered lex rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0067

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0067: tests/ui/cffi_e3206_reserved_segment.stderr.

Error [E0067]: `__bindgen__` is reserved for Jet
  --> tests/ui/cffi_e3206_reserved_segment.jet:1:23
    |
  1 | #Extern module c.demo.__bindgen__ {
    |                       ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: double-underscore names belong to the compiler, generated binders, debugger, serializer, and tools
 Fix: rename it without the second leading underscore
